title: Meetings
description: Record only after everyone agrees. Audio, transcription and speaker identification stay on this device. Notes use your configured AI provider. Dictation pauses while meeting audio is transcribed.
localSpeakers: Sortformer identifies anonymous voices across the combined recording. You assign participant names. The recommended model supports up to four speakers; larger meetings need a compatible model with more speakers. Names do not carry across meetings.
modelMissing: Select a compatible diarization GGUF or download the recommended model before identifying speakers.
downloadingModel: Downloading and verifying the speaker model. No audio is sent. An interrupted download can be retried.
timelineExplanation: Times share the recording clock, including source delays and gaps. This model supports up to {{count}} speakers. Speaker IDs are model estimates; review and correct them.
newParticipant: Add a participant label for manual assignment
overlapExplanation: Overlapping speech is transcribed once as shared, unassigned text because the local speech model cannot separate simultaneous voices. The diarizer's active voice IDs remain visible. You can correct the text or assign a speaker after reviewing it.
staleNotes: The transcript or participant labels changed after these notes were generated. Existing notes and confirmed actions have been preserved; review them against the corrected transcript.
processing: Processing. Your audio is preserved if this operation fails.
draftExplanation: Review each draft before confirming it. Confirmation records a local task; it does not contact anyone. Confirmed actions are preserved by disabling note regeneration.
